title: [DocDB] Fix flaky test PgIndexBackfillTest.VectorIndex
body:
Jira Link: [DB-15446](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-15446)
### Description

This test is flaky on trunk:
```
ybd --cxx-test pg_index_backfill-test --gtest_filter '*.VectorIndex'
```

log messages from one failure:
```
../../src/yb/yql/pgwrapper/pg_index_backfill-test.cc:2616: Failure
Failed
Bad status: Network error (yb/yql/pgwrapper/libpq_utils.cc:449): Execute of 'COMMIT' failed: 7, message: ERROR:  current transaction is expired or aborted (query layer retry isn't possible because data was already sent, if this is the read committed isolation (or) the first statement in repeatable read/ serializable isolation transaction, consider increasing the tserver gflag ysql_output_buffer_size)
DETAIL:  Transaction aborted: kAborted (pgsql error 40001) (aux msg ERROR:  current transaction is expired or aborted (query layer retry isn't possible because data was already sent, if this is the read committed isolation (or) the first statement in repeatable read/ serializable isolation transaction, consider increasing the tserver gflag ysql_output_buffer_size)
DETAIL:  Transaction aborted: kAborted)
[ts-1] 2025-02-19 11:31:09.572 PST [1689650] ERROR:  current transaction is expired or aborted (query layer retry isn't possible because data was already sent, if this is the read committed isolation (or) the first statement in repeatable read/ serializable isolation transaction, consider increasing the tserver gflag ysql_output_buffer_size)
```
